mathematics.assertion_tested: Compute Bianchi-I Einstein momentum components from curvature; derive matter T0x from inverse-metric variation including gamma X Box chi; derive scalar generalized shift current and its equality T0x=b Jchi; numerically test original archived nonzero-charge history at five unchanged L192 Yt values.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy symbolic rational differential algebra and IEEE754 float64 archive evaluations
mathematics.conventions: Signature(-+++); proper time; diagonal Bianchi-I ds2=-dt2+ax2 dx2+ay2 dy2+az2 dz2; tau=tau(t),chi=C(t)+b*x with constant b; Q=Cdot,Y=b2/ax2; constant gamma; P,W,V depend on tau and invariants but not chi. Comoving ordinary fluids have no momentum. Metric off-diagonal variation changes both symmetric entries.
inputs: Same frozen EH+P-V+sW+gamma X Box chi action
Original radiation_002 branch and conserved scalar charge
Five recorded L192 positive Yt values with physical Q and frozen qbar reference
non_claims: Not a universal no-go for finite gradients, a locally uniform WKB patch, tilted matter, tilted clocks, or inhomogeneous metrics.
Does not exclude or construct all zero-shift-charge Bianchi-I branches.
No full background evolution, nonlinear attractor, principal-symbol certificate, or observational completion.
Required expansion rates are necessary algebraic diagnostics, not fitted coefficients or solved backgrounds.
Five finite-gradient points are not asserted to be one trajectory; b is constant only within each homogeneous ansatz.
